defective.description: Item arrived broken or stopped working shortly after delivery.

wrong_item.description: Customer received a different item than what was ordered.

not_as_described.description: Item materially differs from its listing.

changed_mind.description: Standard no-fault return; customer no longer wants the item.

duplicate_charge.description: Customer was billed more than once for the same order.

late_delivery.description: Delivery arrived significantly later than promised; refund is discretionary and needs human judgment on partial vs full refund.

fraud_suspected.description: Customer reports they did not make this purchase or suspects account compromise.
